Task 5 — Predict-only using previously saved models.

Loads fitted forecasters that were persisted by a prior ``LazyTask`` or
``DefaultsTask`` run (or by any task in the ``spotforecast2`` sibling
package) and produces predictions for all configured targets.  No
training or tuning is performed.

If no saved models exist in the cache directory the ``run`` method
raises ``RuntimeError`` with an informative message.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#bbb9e44d .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from spotforecast2_safe.multitask import PredictTask
from spotforecast2_safe.configurator.config_multi import ConfigMulti

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    cfg = ConfigMulti(data_frame_name="demo10", predict_size=24, cache_home=Path(tmp))
    task = PredictTask(cfg)
    print(f"Task: {task.TASK}")
    print(f"Predict size: {task.config.predict_size}")
```

### run { #spotforecast2_safe.multitask.predict.PredictTask.run }

```python
multitask.predict.PredictTask.run(
    show=False,
    task_name=None,
    max_age_days=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Run prediction using previously saved models.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                                  | Default   |
|--------------|---------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| show         | [bool](`bool`)                                    | If ``True``, invoke the visualisation hooks.                                                                                                                                 | `False`   |
| task_name    | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]     | Restrict model loading to a specific source task (``"lazy"``, ``"defaults"``, ``"optuna"``, or ``"spotoptim"``).  ``None`` loads the most recent model regardless of source. | `None`    |
| max_age_days | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[float](`float`)\] | Maximum age in days for saved models. Models older than this are ignored.  ``None`` accepts any age.                                                                         | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                                                   |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Aggregated prediction package. Per-target packages are stored |
|        | [Dict](`typing.Dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | on ``self.results["predict"]``.                               |
